info.title: dt-docs: build and check a project docs site.
info.description: Builds and checks a project docs site: Docusaurus with sections and sign-in from docs.json, rule IDs linked to their definitions, and a MANIFEST check. Bundles Bun and the site, so it needs nothing else installed.

commands.name: build
commands.description: Check, then build the site into build/, sign-in included

commands.name: check
commands.description: Check docs.json, MANIFEST.md and rule IDs

commands.name: dev
commands.description: Serve the site locally, reloading as you edit

commands.name: guide
commands.description: Print the writing guide for a kind of page

commands.name: new
commands.description: Create a page from a page template

commands.name: serve
commands.description: Serve the last build, with search
